versions.name: C.W. Post Memorial Scout Camp

features.note: campers sleep in bunkhouses, which the camp promotes as the way to beat the summer heat
canoe instruction run in the camp pool
climbing offered among the camp's adventure activities
trail to first class track run over two sessions
art, leatherwork, and indian lore taught as badges
scenic trails through the ravines of the caprock escarpment
kayak instruction run in the camp pool
badge offered to campers who hold a state motorboat permit before arrival
a very large pool that doubles as the canoe and kayak training water

versions.summary: South Plains Council Scouts BSA camp in Garza County near Post, Texas, offering horseback riding, mountain biking, climbing, and shooting sports, along with a 135,000-gallon pool.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types.
